name: THE BELL-RINGER
note: Doc 07 #4: 'Church steps. Strikes the bell by hand, half a step flat, drunk.' Errata 161: he stands at the foot of the church steps on Lower Street, by the bell on its post, and strikes it. His tree and his barks are doc 07's, extracted; doc 97's Overrides answer a wrong verb on him.

barks.R_SWINDLED: Heard you got took. That was for you.

barkCuesNote: Doc 07 #4's directions, played: (strikes) once, (strikes twice), (strikes, half-heartedly), (strikes four times), and R_DEAD's passing bell, a slow toll. The bell is the town's flat bell (tools/audio/render-everyday-sfx.py, church-bell.wav), so it is the same note the street hears.

sprite.note: Frames 0-1 are the idle: the rest pose and its breath. Frames 2-3 are the strike: the mallet up, then down on the bell. Frame 4 is talking. His strike is a break that SOUNDS (`breakCues`): a blow in silence reads as a fault. The other break raises the mallet and thinks better of it.
sprite.frameNote: 0 rest, the mallet down at his side · 1 breath · 2 the mallet raised · 3 the blow · 4 talking, a hand out.
sprite.figureHeightNote: ERRATA 235 (Tyler, 2026-11-09: everyone within 3% of Thad). Crown to sole under his bowler, read from his eyes and chin: 265. Was 254.6, which took the whole bowler off his height (20 rows; his skull's crown is 8 rows under the hat's top): 1.04 of Thad.
sprite.levelManNote: ERRATA 235: the man its sheet was snapped to one level at (errata 112 G), kept while it is drawn at its new height without a re-snap; the drift is held to 5% (tests/one-level.test.mjs).
sprite.breakEveryNote: Errata 296 (Tyler, 2026-11-12, on the map seller: "doesn't appear to have any movements"): one held pose every 17 s read as standing still. Now every 12 s.

barksNote: EXTRACTED from docs/07-ambient-layer.md (## 4 · THE BELL-RINGER) by tools/extract-content.mjs. Do not edit: change doc 07 and re-run. Every row is a blow on the bell: its words, where the row has any, are the bark, and the blow is `barkCues` (errata 161).
